name: Threat list maker
why: Ranks the likeliest attacks on an app before the roles and privacy rules are set.

name: Prepare a new data use for review
why: Runs a privacy assessment of a new use of customer data before a portal goes live.

name: Quarterly compliance readiness keeper
why: Tracks GDPR readiness gaps each quarter, alongside the monthly access and usage review.

name: Check a prototype before user testing
why: Finds test blockers and neutral task wording before the client tries the test version.

name: Small usability test planner
why: Plans a short test with real staff or clients on the test version before launch.

name: Error message rewriter
why: Rewrites error states in plain words, for the error state on every page card.

name: Design handoff completeness assistant
why: Finds missing states and variants before a builder starts, like the page spec's empty, loading and error checks.

name: MVP experiment planner
why: Plans the smallest test of an app idea before a full build.

name: Check a spreadsheet before sharing the results
why: Finds broken formulas and wrong totals in a sheet before it becomes an app's data source.

name: Excel workbook handover writer
why: Writes a handover for a workbook's next owner, useful when a sheet stays part of the app.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a restore test so the backup behind a live data import is proven first.
